name: Panther Mastery
summary: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition offers a trial to those seeking to prove their prowess as big-game stalkers in Stranglethorn Vale. To join Hemet's hunting company, adventurers must first demonstrate their basic tracking ability by taking down ten young panthers.

sections.title: A Crack Group of Hunters
sections.body: Within the wild expanse of northern Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary has assembled a seasoned band of big-game huntsmen. Sir S. J. Erlgadin tells anyone who wants a part of the hunt that they must first prove themselves an able panther hunter.

sections.title: Tracking the Prowlers
sections.body: Before Erlgadin entrusts anyone with greater game, he issues an entry test: finding and slaying ten young panthers. Simply finding the beasts is only half the challenge.

faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin gives this challenge from the camp of Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale, testing newcomers who want to join Hemet's hunting party.

aliases: what do i kill for panther mastery
faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin directs hunters to track down and slay ten young panthers roaming the surrounding jungle brush.

faq.q: Why does Sir S. J. Erlgadin assign this test?
faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary has gathered a seasoned hunting crew, and Erlgadin wants newcomers to prove themselves able panther hunters before they join the hunt.

faq.q: What comes next after completing this hunt?
faq.answer: Completing this opening trial leads directly to Panther Mastery (2), where Sir S. J. Erlgadin increases the difficulty of the quarry.
